content.text:
Found two issues in PR #32 at `1640eee`, both affecting LangGraph and CrewAI:

- **P1 — Session round trips erase transcripts.** [protocol_wrapper.py:88–91](https://github.com/entireio/external-agents/blob/1640eee9b0a33efff4cd2bcfbe3f5d18d3e91364/agents/entire-agent-langgraph/protocol_wrapper.py#L88-L91) converts `native_data: null` to empty bytes and overwrites the transcript. The underlying package returns exactly that null value for fresh sessions. Reproduced a read/write round trip reducing a 36-byte transcript to zero. Preserve the file when native data is absent.

- **P2 — Restored sessions return stale transcript data.** [protocol_wrapper.py:105–113](https://github.com/entireio/external-agents/blob/1640eee9b0a33efff4cd2bcfbe3f5d18d3e91364/agents/entire-agent-langgraph/protocol_wrapper.py#L105-L113) returns the saved sidecar without rereading the transcript. After restoration and additional messages, `read-session` still returns the original bytes; writing that result back loses subsequent messages. Reproduced a 73-byte live transcript returning only its original 34 bytes. Refresh native data from the transcript when reading.

Validated both issues in both wrappers with focused reproductions. Full lifecycle tests weren’t run; GitHub reports no checks on the PR branch.
